title: Start Here
subtitle: Welcome to ComplianceOS - Your GRC Platform
description: Choose a workflow to get started with your compliance journey.

riskAssessment.title: Risk Assessment
riskAssessment.description: Identify, analyze, and evaluate security risks to your organization.
riskAssessment.goal: Complete a comprehensive risk register and treatment plan.

steps.identifyAssetsDesc: Catalog your critical information assets (hardware, software, data).
steps.identifyRisksDesc: Determine threats and vulnerabilities affecting your assets.
steps.assessImpactDesc: Score risks based on likelihood and impact.
steps.treatRisksDesc: Decide to mitigate, accept, avoid, or transfer risks.

gapAnalysis.title: Gap Analysis
gapAnalysis.description: Assess your current security posture against industry standards.
gapAnalysis.goal: Identify compliance gaps and create a remediation roadmap.

steps.selectFrameworkDesc: Define your target standard (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST).
steps.currentStateDesc: Evaluate existing controls against framework requirements.

complianceAudit.title: Compliance Audit
complianceAudit.description: Prepare for and manage compliance audits effectively.
complianceAudit.goal: Achieve audit-ready status and maintain continuous compliance.

steps.evidenceCollectionDesc: Gather documentation and evidence for controls.
steps.auditReadinessDesc: Verify all required evidence is in place.

policyManagement.title: Policy Management
policyManagement.description: Create, manage, and distribute security policies across your organization.

steps.createPoliciesDesc: Develop security policies aligned with your framework.
steps.distributePoliciesDesc: Share policies with employees and track acknowledgments.

vendorAssessment.title: Vendor Assessment
vendorAssessment.description: Evaluate and monitor third-party vendor security risks.
vendorAssessment.goal: Maintain a vendor risk register and assessment program.

steps.identifyVendorsDesc: Catalog all third-party vendors with data access.
steps.assessVendorsDesc: Evaluate vendor security controls and risk levels.

trainingAwareness.title: Training & Awareness
trainingAwareness.description: Develop and track security awareness training for employees.
trainingAwareness.goal: Ensure all employees complete required security training.

steps.createTrainingDesc: Develop training modules for security topics.
steps.assignTrainingDesc: Assign training to employees and track completion.
